articles.title: Sensex jumps 400 points, Nifty above 23,900  as investors eye US midterm poll outcome. What lies ahead?
articles.desc: The Indian stock market has surged, with both Sensex and Nifty climbing to their highest points in two months. As investors keep a keen eye on outcomes from the US midterm elections, which could influence international exchanges, major sectors such as Realty and FMCG have thrived. There's a marked increase in buying from foreign institutional investors, suggesting renewed confidence in large-cap stocks.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal holds talks with Danish minister to expand economic partnership
articles.desc: India and Denmark are actively exploring various opportunities to strengthen their economic engagement and partnerships. The discussions between Piyush Goyal and Martin Lidegaard emphasized collaborative efforts in trade, investment, and industrial cooperation. Approximately 250 Danish companies operate in India, employing over 100,000 individuals while showing strong interest in further investments. Cooperation in renewable energy and wind energy technologies has been a core focus of their partnership.

articles.title: US midterm elections: Early Democratic wins rattle Wall Street
articles.desc: Early Democratic victories in key US Senate races have raised expectations of a potential shift in control of Congress, although the final outcome remains uncertain. The emerging results triggered a sharp reaction across financial markets, with US stock futures falling, Treasury yields declining and the dollar weakening as investors assessed the implications of a possible Democratic sweep.

articles.desc: With Diwali 2026 on the horizon, banking stocks like HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Karur Vysya Bank are drawing attention from analysts as potential winners for Samvat 2083. Following a period of volatility, these stocks are anticipated to regain momentum, driven by consistent loan growth and enhanced management practices. Investors are advised to navigate the changing landscape prudently as opportunities unfold.

articles.title: Gig workers may get social security benefits through 2% transaction levy on businesses
articles.desc: The government is considering implementing a 2% transaction-based levy on aggregators to support social security for gig workers. This levy will fund benefits such as insurance, health, and maternity support for over 12 million workers. There is a consensus that this approach ensures fairness among different types of aggregators. The new scheme is expected to be launched in 2027, requiring gig workers to meet specific work criteria.

articles.title: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels shares list at 6% premium over IPO price
articles.desc: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels made its stock market debut at a 6% premium over its IPO price. The company raised Rs 275.40 crore through its initial public offering, which saw high investor interest. Shares opened at Rs 171 compared to the issue price of Rs 162, indicating strong demand. The company's financial performance showed significant growth, with income rising to Rs 539 crore in FY26.

articles.title: US midterm election betting surges past $1.4 billion as Democrats score major wins
articles.desc: Betting on the 2026 US midterm elections has crossed $1.4 billion, putting prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket to a major test. Strong Democratic gains have triggered sharp movements in election-related contracts, drawing attention to the platforms' growing influence. However, concerns over manipulation, insider trading and forecasting accuracy continue to challenge their credibility as political forecasting tools.

articles.title: MCX shares tumble 7% even as Q2 net profit surges 130% YoY, revenue more than doubles
articles.desc: MCX shares fell nearly 7% despite reporting 130% growth in second-quarter net profit and a 114% rise in revenue. Jefferies said EBITDA was largely in line with estimates, while higher technology costs and taxes affected the results.

articles.title: Meta raises $15 billion in five-part US bond sale
articles.desc: The tech giant's offering adds to a wave of fundraising as companies raise fresh capital to finance AI data centers, computing capacity and cloud expansion, despite traditionally relying on cash-rich balance sheets to fund growth.

articles.title: SBI share price target: Jefferies, Motilal, others see up to 34% upside in state lender. Buy, sell or hold?
articles.desc: State Bank of India has seen a remarkable 15% increase in profits year-on-year, totaling Rs 23,038 crore for the second quarter. With a loan book surpassing Rs 52 lakh crore and a 10% rise in interest income, brokerages have set optimistic Buy ratings on SBI shares, suggesting target prices between Rs 1,225 and Rs 1,350. Despite this positive outlook, management highlighted possible obstacles from macroeconomic shifts and potential treasury losses.

articles.title: India's palm oil imports hit 14-month high, soyoil purchases set record
articles.desc: In October, India experienced a surge in palm oil imports to 866,000 metric tons. Soyoil imports reached a record high of 653,000 tons, reflecting increased demand. The overall edible oil imports rose by 13%, reaching 1.74 million tons during the festive season. This demand is driven by concerns about limited domestic supplies and El Nino-related crop damage.

articles.title: MCX gold prices at Rs 1.39 lakh/10 gram; silver tanks Rs 2,000/kg as US jobs data fuels rate hike bets. Key levels to track ahead of Dhanteras
articles.desc: In the domestic market, MCX silver futures for December 2026 delivery were down by Rs 2,000 to Rs 1,77,784 per kg. Gold futures for December 2026 delivery fell marginally to Rs 1,30,300 per 10 grams.

articles.title: Gold prices ahead of Dhanteras: Up 10% in a year, but is the worst of correction still ahead?
articles.desc: Gold has outperformed the Nifty and Sensex since Dhanteras 2025, despite falling sharply from its January peak. With inflation concerns, Fed rate expectations and weak demand weighing on prices, analysts remain divided on its near-term outlook, while major banks see scope for a recovery in 2027.

articles.title: NSE shares gain as Jefferies, other brokerages remain bullish after Q2 results. What lies ahead?
articles.desc: NSE reported a 23% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 2,578 crore, driven by higher trading volumes and transaction revenue. The exchange also approved divesting up to 40% stake in its coal exchange subsidiary. Jefferies and Emkay maintained Buy ratings, projecting further upside in NSE shares.

articles.title: Two SME IPOs list today: Carver Roboweld, Ajwa Projects shares make BSE SME debut
articles.desc: Ajwa Projects and Carver Roboweld are set to list on the BSE SME platform on November 4, 2026, after collectively raising Rs 66.34 crore. While Ajwa Projects’ IPO received modest subscription of 1.12 times, Carver Roboweld attracted strong investor demand, achieving an overall subscription of 25.80 times.

articles.title: Nikkei slides to 3-month low as AI stocks tumble on US election jitters
articles.desc: Japan's Nikkei index took a hit as AI-driven stocks plummeted following the aftermath of the US elections, raising alarms over potential Democratic control tightening data-centre regulations. Major players in the tech industry, such as Advantest and SoftBank Group, experienced significant drops in their stock values. Nonetheless, Fast Retailing managed to post slight gains, offering a degree of stability to the overall Nikkei performance amidst a gloomy market outlook.

articles.desc: At least 63 stocks with a market capitalisation of over Rs 1,000 crore have lost more than half their value since last Diwali, with some plunging 60-95% amid a broad-based selloff across sectors. Elitecon International was the worst performer, tumbling 96%, followed by Reliance Infrastructure, Kothari Industrial Corporation and Fischer Medical Ventures.

articles.title: Festive demand lifts dry fruit, chocolate imports this season
articles.desc: During the festive season, India's import of tree nuts and chocolates rose significantly, reflecting a 10-12% annual demand increase. The reduction in goods and services tax has made these gourmet products more accessible to consumers. In 2025, dry fruit imports during this period accounted for a substantial share of annual purchases.

articles.title: Festive season: Pistachio prices nearly double, almonds up 20% on West Asia crisis and US crop shortfall
articles.desc: "Pistachio have been the game spoiler this year. The prices of pistachio from all origins including Iran, Afghanistan and California have increased," said Ravindra Mehta, member of central governing council at Nuts and Dry Fruits Council of India (NDFC-I). "The current pistachio crop in California is expected to be only about 40% of last year, which has led to an increase of 50% in pista prices in the wholesale markets and even more in retail," he added.

articles.title: Rs 9,000 crore land assets monetised so far in FY27
articles.desc: The NLMC, which is working under the aegis of the Department of Public Enterprises under the finance ministry, also has land assets worth another Rs 4,000-5,000 crore belonging to public sector undertakings (PSUs) in the pipeline. These are at various stages of processing, providing an additional pipeline of potential transactions.

articles.title: Rising crude prices could push India's inflation by upto 1 percentage point, diversified imports helping secure oil supplies: EY's Gaurav Moda
articles.desc: Gaurav Moda, Partner and Energy Industry Leader at EY India said the increase in crude oil prices from an average of $60-65 per barrel to $90-95 has significantly raised India's energy import costs, even as the country continues to prioritise securing supplies amid geopolitical uncertainties.

articles.title: RBI launches 3 surveys to capture inflation expectations, consumer confidence ahead of December policy meeting
articles.desc: Reserve Bank of India has announced the November 2026 round of the Inflation Expectations Survey of Households. This survey aims to capture households' perceptions regarding price movements and inflation based on their consumption patterns. Additionally, the Urban Consumer Confidence Survey seeks to understand household sentiments on the economic situation and employment. The Rural Consumer Confidence Survey collects perceptions from rural areas on economic conditions, income, and spending.

articles.desc: The launch is the first time AI token packages have been offered as a significant consumer product category during Singles' Day, the world's largest shopping festival originally held on November 11 each year.

articles.desc: Britons have become less engaged with the jobs they do and are less willing to put in extra effort, a report has found.

articles.title: India may reimpose broken rice export restrictions as prices cross $360 per tonne: IREF
articles.desc: India may reimpose restrictions on exports of 100% broken rice as international prices cross $360 per tonne and domestic demand from ethanol manufacturers and poultry-feed producers increases, the Indian Rice Exporters' Federation (IREF) has warned. No fresh curbs have been announced so far.

articles.title: India eases forex reporting rules for small value service exports, imports
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India has eased foreign exchange reporting rules for services exports and imports, reducing compliance requirements for resident individuals and setting a ₹1 million threshold for certain transactions. Resident individuals exporting services will be deemed to have filed export declarations after submitting payment details to banks, while reporting obligations for larger transactions and non-individual entities will continue.

articles.title: Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through bonds and stock sales
articles.desc: The company said last week that it expects capital spending to peak this fiscal year and the next as it builds more cloud-computing capacity, but pledged to raise no more than $20 billion in additional financing for AI through fiscal 2030.

articles.title: India has never allowed genetically modified products' import, won't do in future: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India continues to maintain a strict policy against the import of genetically modified products, as stated by Minister Piyush Goyal. He highlighted that the dairy sector remains particularly sensitive and has not been opened in trade agreements. Goyal emphasized India's commitment to protecting its agricultural and fisheries sectors while seeking preferential market access for textiles and pharmaceuticals.

articles.title: Binance co-CEO says company is in very strong financial health after $6.3 billion heist
articles.desc: Teng told a Hong Kong Fintech Week event Binance's hourly inflows and outflows had "pretty much normalised" and 95% of the affected tokens had been replenished.

articles.title: India to make tunnel boring machines at home if China curbs exports: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India is gearing up to start producing its own tunnel boring machines if China decides to limit its exports. This statement came from Piyush Goyal, India's trade minister, after Beijing made its recent announcement. It highlights India’s plan to not rely on foreign supplies and enhance its domestic manufacturing capabilities in this crucial area.

articles.title: No water to sow, no respite at the grocery store: India's prolonged food inflation worry
articles.desc: Indian farmers face challenges in sowing winter crops amid dwindling water supplies from a weak monsoon. Amarsingh Gushinge's village experiences a significant rainfall deficit, impacting crop planting decisions. Food inflation could worsen as key staples see rising prices, aggravating the economic strain on households. The Reserve Bank of India may respond with interest rate hikes to combat rising inflationary pressures.

articles.title: Global markets were already fragile. Big AI bets could break them
articles.desc: Investors flocked to bonds. Yields, which move inversely to price, fell from multidecade highs, with the benchmark 10-year Treasury, which guides borrowing costs globally, falling almost 20 basis points on October 22, its biggest daily fall since early 2023.
